summary: Master data-driven storytelling to influence the C-suite, justify marketing budgets, and drive ROI using advanced analytics and narrative frameworks.
lede: Data-driven storytelling for marketing leaders helps transform complex marketing data into clear, evidence-based narratives that connect investment with business outcomes. You will develop the technical literacy and persuasive communication skills needed to move beyond retrospective vanity metrics and influence strategic discussions. The course covers data synthesis, visual hierarchy, narrative framing, predictive forecasting, and stakeholder alignment through practical work with Tableau or Power BI, Marketing Mix Modeling, Return on Ad Spend analysis, attribution, and Customer Lifetime Value segmentation. You will also learn to create executive dashboards, apply the Freytag Pyramid to performance reviews, design high-fidelity visualizations based on Tufte’s principles, and build data-backed budget proposals for executive scrutiny.
audienceIntro: This program is curated for experienced marketing professionals who oversee data-heavy functions and must communicate findings to non-technical executive stakeholders.
modules: AI and Predictive Analytics in Marketing
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 5 years in a marketing leadership or senior analytical role. Familiarity with basic marketing metrics (CTR, CPA, Conversion Rate) is required. Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Google Looker Studio) is recommended but not mandatory as technical concepts will be covered from a leadership perspective.
